propositions: rebar truncates DC comments at hardcoded WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) instead of respecting the admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property, causing silent data loss when administrators raise the limit
DC's jira.text.field.character.limit default is 32767 per jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519, but ranges from 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647, making the hardcoded value wrong for non-stock instances

the comment sanitizer was coupled to the description fitter (fit_outbound) via shared truncation logic, creating a latent defect where changes to description fitting could unintentionally retarget comment truncation

configurability was added via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with default 32767, environment override REBAR_RECONCILER_COMMENT_MAX_CHARS, and range validation matching the Jira property's documented bounds

the comment path was decoupled from the description fitter by introducing _truncate_dc_comment_body and removing WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT from backend.py imports, preserving byte-identity at default ceiling
